blocks.x: You don’t have them in numbered order there...
You want to read it out loud?
No. You want to read them...
How about Amy reads it, since I think you’ve sung it...

I haven’t sung that, but other people have. Bonnie Raitt and Elvis Costello. “I can’t believe the things I’m seeing / I went about some things I’ve heard / Everybody’s crying mercy / When they don’t know the meaning of the word / A bad enough situation / Is sure enough getting worse / Everybody’s crying justice / Just as long as there’s business first / Toe to toe / Touch and go / Give a cheer / Get your souvenir / People running around in circles / Don’t know what they’re head for / Everybody’s crying peace on earth / Just as soon as we win this war / Straight ahead / Knock ‘em dead / Pack your kit / Choose your hypocrite / Well, you don’t have to go to a movie / To see something plain absurd / Everybody’s cryin’ mercy / When they don’t know the meaning of the word / Nobody knows the meaning of the word.”
